topic: Ambedkar & the Making of the Constitution

items.back: Born 14 Apr 1891, Mhow (Mahar family). PhD Columbia, D.Sc. LSE, Barrister Gray's Inn.
items.examPoint: Ambedkar early life & education (1891 Mhow; Columbia, LSE, Gray's Inn)

items.back: Asserted water rights at Chavdar tank; the Manusmriti was publicly burned (25 Dec 1927).
items.examPoint: Mahad Satyagraha (1927) — Chavdar tank & Manusmriti burning

items.back: Mooknayak (1920, aided by Shahu of Kolhapur), Bahishkrit Bharat (1927); Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha (1924).
items.examPoint: Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha & journals (Mooknayak, Bahishkrit Bharat)

items.back: Communal Award gave separate electorates to Depressed Classes; Poona Pact (Sept 1932, with Gandhi) replaced them with reserved seats in a joint electorate.
items.examPoint: Poona Pact (1932) with Gandhi — reserved seats replace separate electorates

items.front: Who proposed the Constituent Assembly & under which plan was it set up?
items.back: Idea by M.N. Roy (1934); set up under the Cabinet Mission Plan (1946); first meeting 9 Dec 1946.
items.examPoint: Demand & evolution of the Constituent Assembly (M.N. Roy 1934 → Cabinet Mission 1946)

items.back: 389 seats (→299 after partition); provincial members indirectly elected by provincial assemblies via proportional representation/STV.
items.examPoint: Composition of the Constituent Assembly (389 → 299 seats; election method)

items.back: Provisional President Sachchidananda Sinha; permanent President Rajendra Prasad; VP H.C. Mukherjee; Advisor B.N. Rau.
items.examPoint: First meeting & office-bearers (Sinha, Rajendra Prasad, Mukherjee, B.N. Rau)

items.back: Moved by Nehru on 13 Dec 1946; adopted 22 Jan 1947; became the basis of the Preamble.
Formed 29 Aug 1947; 7 members; chaired by B.R. Ambedkar ('Father of the Indian Constitution').
items.examPoint: Drafting Committee — Ambedkar as chairman & its seven members (29 Aug 1947)

items.back: Union Powers — Nehru; States/Advisory — Patel; Drafting — Ambedkar; Rules — Rajendra Prasad.
items.examPoint: Major committees of the Assembly & their chairmen

items.back: Adopted 26 Nov 1949; came into force 26 Jan 1950; took 2 years 11 months 18 days.
items.examPoint: Timeline & duration of constitution-making (adopted 26 Nov 1949; enforced 26 Jan 1950)

items.back: National Flag adopted 22 July 1947; National Anthem & Song adopted 24 January 1950.
items.examPoint: Other CA members (K.C. Neogy → First Finance Commission; H.C. Mukherjee; Frank Anthony) & national symbols (flag 22 Jul 1947, anthem/song 24 Jan 1950)

items.back: Constituent Assembly member; chaired the First Finance Commission (1951).
items.examPoint: Other CA members (K.C. Neogy → First Finance Commission; H.C. Mukherjee; Frank Anthony) & national symbols (flag 22 Jul 1947, anthem/song 24 Jan 1950)

items.front: Andhra members of the Constituent Assembly?
items.back: Durgabai Deshmukh, Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar (Drafting Cttee), N.G. Ranga, Pattabhi Sitaramayya, T. Prakasam, Neelam Sanjeeva Reddy.
items.examPoint: Andhra members of the Constituent Assembly

items.back: First Law Minister; resigned 1951 (Hindu Code Bill); embraced Buddhism at Nagpur 14 Oct 1956; died 6 Dec 1956; Bharat Ratna 1990.
items.examPoint: Ambedkar as first Law Minister; Hindu Code Bill resignation & 1956 Buddhist conversion
